articles.title: Alcaraz's Big Comeback Sends Jodar to the ATP Finals
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz saved two match points to beat Taylor Fritz, and his win booked 20-year-old Jodar a first-ever spot at the season-ending ATP Finals in Turin.

articles.title: Baby Whale Surprises Scientists
articles.summary: A right whale named Silt secretly raised a sixth calf, spotted near Anticosti Island, welcome news for a critically endangered species of about 384 whales.

articles.title: Matt Damon's Ship From 'The Odyssey' Needs Your Help
articles.summary: The real wooden ship that played Odysseus' galley in Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey needs volunteers for spring maintenance in Norway.
